data.name: self-indulgence
data.detailed_description:
“When you’re finally there for yourself… will you be able to shoulder it?”

Self-Indulgence is a PSX-style psychological horror game that drags you deep into a decaying world where memories rot and truth is a shifting shadow.

Guided only by fading memories and desperation, a father searches for his missing child—only to uncover something far more disturbing than he ever imagined. What begins as a rescue turns into a descent into the unknown.

🔸 Retro survival horror, reimagined – tank controls, fixed camera angles, gritty textures
🔸 A story-driven nightmare – every clue pulls you deeper
🔸 2 major free updates coming post-launch
🔸 No jumpscares. Just dread.

If you loved the eerie silence of Silent Hill, the tension of Resident Evil, and the mystery of Lost, you’re going to feel right at home—and very, very uncomfortable.

Are you ready to remember what you’ve tried to forget?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1, Windows 8.1, or Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850 with 2GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 with 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible

content_descriptors.notes: There is a gun in the game, which character can shoot enemies. There is also blood.
